name: Miranda de Azán (Spain)
description: Square white flag with a red dancetty stripe along the upper edge, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Miranda de Azán (a crescent on green and a castle on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Miranda de Azán; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: stripe along the upper edge with a zigzag lower edge
Miranda de Azán arms — crescent on green and castle on yellow
yellow field and crown of the arms
